top_signals.title: Spotify Rallies on Subscribers; Hermès falls on China Sales | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
- Shares of Procter & Gamble (PG) moved higher ahead of the US market open after the company's sales and profits beat Wall Street expectations. Organic revenue rose 4% in the first quarter, the fastest growth in three years. 
- Shares of Spotify (SPOT) rallied after results and forecast spoke to improving margin trends. Spotify reported that the service’s paying subscribers increased 2% to hit 306 million in the third quarter, topping Wall Street estimates of 305.1 million. 
- Hermès (RMS FP) reported disappointing sales in the third quarter on sluggish demand in China. Their 41% slump so far this year puts them on track for the worst annual performance since the company listed in 1993.
- Shares of Lam Research (LRCX) fell in premarket trading after the semiconductor capital equipment company gave a forecast for adjusted second-quarter earnings slightly weaker than expected. (Source: Bloomberg)

alerts.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
alerts.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructure. Hurricane Isaias is the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season and will be the largest storm system to make landfall in the region since Hurricane Helene in September 2024.

alerts.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
alerts.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
